sql: SELECT i.unit, s.follow_up_enabled AS f1, s.follow_up_delay_hours AS h1, s.follow_up_2_enabled AS f2, s.follow_up_2_delay_hours AS h2, s.follow_up_3_enabled AS f3, s.follow_up_3_delay_hours AS h3, s.follow_up_4_enabled AS f4, s.follow_up_4_delay_hours AS h4, s.follow_up_min_hour, s.follow_up_max_hour, s.auto_lost_enabled, s.auto_lost_delay_hours, left(s.follow_up_message, 160) AS msg1, left(s.follow_up_2_message, 160) AS msg2 FROM wapi_bot_settings s JOIN wapi_instances i ON i.id = s.instance_id WHERE i.company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' AND i.is_active ORDER BY i.unit
